interface.name: org_kde_kwin_server_decoration_manager
interface.description: Offered by a compositor that draws window frames. It announces the mode it uses for windows by default and creates one decoration object per surface whose client takes part.

request.name: create

description.summary: a decoration object for a surface

request.description: Taking part: a window whose surface has a decoration object lets the compositor frame it. A window without one draws its own frame.

event.name: default_mode

description.summary: the mode the compositor uses by default

event.description: Sent once on binding. 0 none, 1 client, 2 server.

interface.name: org_kde_kwin_server_decoration
interface.description: The decoration of one surface: the mode the client would like, and the mode the compositor uses. 0 none, 1 client, 2 server.

description.summary: the mode the client would like
